{
  "verdict": "pass with notes",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "severity": "minor",
      "category": "PII Exposure",
      "file": "packages/web/src/grid/components/AttendeeBadge.tsx",
      "what": "AttendeeBadge falls back to raw email addresses (`a.displayName ?? a.email`) in the hover `title` attribute and accessibility `aria-label` when displayName is null.",
      "why_it_matters": "Calendar grids are frequently screen-shared during meetings. Hovering over badge dots on the always-visible grid can unintentionally broadcast attendee email addresses to screen-share viewers, whereas this data previously required an explicit click to open the event form.",
      "fix": "Avoid falling back to raw email addresses in grid tooltips/aria-labels; fall back to a generic placeholder (e.g. 'Attendee') or truncate/mask the email address.",
      "inside_allowlist": true
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "severity": "minor",
      "category": "Resource / DoS",
      "file": "packages/web/src/grid/components/AttendeeBadge.tsx",
      "what": "The `summaryLabel` in AttendeeBadge iterates and maps over the entire `attendees` array without a cap to construct the `aria-label` string on every render.",
      "why_it_matters": "For events with large attendee lists (e.g., 500+ attendees), performing uncapped string transformations on every drag or resize re-render frame can degrade main-thread rendering performance across multiple event cards.",
      "fix": "Cap the `summaryLabel` attendee iteration to `MAX_BADGE_ATTENDEES` and summarize overflow (e.g. `Attendees: Alice (accepted), Bob (declined) and 498 others`), or summarize with counts.",
      "inside_allowlist": true
    }
  ],
  "pii_assessment": "Attendee identity data (display names and fallback email addresses) is now rendered on the main calendar grid within DOM `title` tooltips and `aria-label` attributes. While the underlying attendee data was already accessible to the client in memory, moving it from behind a click in the event edit form to the persistently visible grid creates an accidental exposure vector during screen-sharing or shoulder-surfing when hovering over status dots. Furthermore, the `aria-label` enumerates all attendee statuses rather than only visible indicators. A Gate ruling should determine whether displaying raw fallback emails on grid hover is acceptable or if fallback masking/generic labelling should be enforced on high-visibility surfaces.",
  "clean_categories": [
    "Injection (XSS / CSS / URL Sink)",
    "Dependencies / Supply Chain"
  ],
  "required_before_signoff": "Address the raw email fallback in AttendeeBadge tooltip and cap the summaryLabel aria-label generation to prevent performance issues with large attendee lists before final release."
}
